maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.detail-9: The smell hits first. A red tide covers the floor, neither water nor flesh, rippling with every step as it draws you deeper inside.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue: The stone gleams red wet. The air is stagnant, carrying the taste of rust, heavy and sour on the tongue.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-10: The same plea reaches your mind.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-11: It wants you to kill it.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-12: You can grant its wish, or walk away.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-15: The guardians are shattered back into the red flood. You can hear only the pulse of the chamber itself.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-16: The core writhes among the roots. Once again, something forces its way into your mind.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-17: You feel its suffering. Constant, unbearable, with no end in sight.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-18: It pleads, not with a voice but with the weight of suffering:
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-2: Something vast lingers here. Its presence pressed into the walls and the marrow of the floor.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-23: Your strike pierces the writhing core.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-24: For a moment the chamber stills. Then the roots collapse inward, dissolving into the crimson flood.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-25: What remains is silence, broken only by the drip of red against stone.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-26: The plea ends. So does the prisoner.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-28: The guardians convulse, their bodies unraveling as though their existence depended on the Source's torment.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-3: Event opening (Party member required: Companion: ixarion)
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-30: You lower your hand. The chamber trembles, as though in disbelief.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-31: Its half-formed face twists, then sinks back into the mass of flesh and roots.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-32: The same desperate plea reaches your mind once more.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-36: Behind you, the Source remains alive, trapped in its endless suffering.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-37: The smell hits first. A red tide covers the floor, neither water nor flesh, rippling with every step as it draws you deeper inside.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-38: Blackened columns rise like ribs, their stone threaded with faintly pulsing growths.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-39: At the chamber's heart writhes a husk, not tree, not spirit, not wholly flesh, its rootlike tendrils choking walls and stone alike.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-4: "These places are forbidden to me, mortal. Here, your little names and bindings hold no power over me."
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-40: Within the mass, remnants of form remain, a half-swallowed face, the curve of ribs suspended in red light.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-41: Then comes the pressure. Not a voice, but a thought forced into your skull, words broken beyond repair.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-42: KILLLLLLLLLL...... The sound tears the air.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-43: The red floor heaves, and from its swell climb figures.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-44: Hulks of coagulated matter, bone splinters jutting like teeth, shoulders hunched with rage not their own.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-45: Guardians, raised long ago to protect the thing at the heart of this chamber. They move, slow and terrible, to bar your path.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-7: Event opening (There are still enemies alive (Blood Golem))
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-8: The chamber is as you left it. The red liquid lies still, but the roots surrounding the Source continue to twitch.
maps.points.mausoleum_3_2.dialogue-9: The twisted figure at the center stirs. Its half-formed face turns toward you.
